title: The 23rd or the 24th
what_we_know: The captains' chart is hand-dated 23 February 1945 and numbered Mission #7. The crew record puts mission seven on the 24th, at Bremen.
what_we_dont: Which date is right, and whose hand dated the chart.
what_might_answer_it: The group's mission reports for 23 and 24 February 1945; the other thirteen charts, once digitized.
evidence_needed: A document of 1945 dating mission seven, or the chart's annotator identified.
